note: The English credit card listing at /personal/cards/credit-cards is a Next.js page that also embeds the same tiles in HTML. Each featured product is one div.styles_productContainer__Duxrm with a p.styles_productCardTitle__Sy437 name and a Learn More link. On 2026-11-24 the carousel had 9 cards. The comparison page at /personal/cards/credit-cards/comparison-page adds Toyota Mastercard, Metrobank Rewards Plus Card, and Metrobank Platinum Mastercard (World Mastercard is already on the listing). Metrobank ICON at /personal/cards/credit-cards/icon and Vantage Mastercard at /personal/cards/credit-cards/vantage-mastercard also have official product pages and were handed in. The Secured Credit Card page is an application path (holdout deposit, 99 percent approval) and was not handed in as a separate product. Apply Now buttons go to apply.metrobank.com.ph, which is a subdomain not in official_domains and is not fetched. The official host robots.txt allows these paths. There is no language switcher; pages are in English.
